text: Очередная игра, вымогающая деньги. Начну с того, что в игре я провел более 400 часов в общей сложности. На каждом ходу игра от вас хочет, чтобы вы что-то купили за реальные деньги, даже при простом переходе в меню (н.п. из клана в магазин и наоборот). Если же ты хочешь получить подарки, то в 99% случаев - смотри рекламу. Раньше рекламы было меньше, теперь хоть по часу в день трать только на рекламу и уже потом играй. Каждая новая ДД пешка - новая мета. Понятно для чего, чтобы люди снова платили за нее, качали до максимального уровня и т.д. И так по кругу. Если же ты не будешь платить деньги, то будешь чувствовать себя ущербно, прокачка невероятно долгая и мучительная. Предлагаю сменить жанр игры с карточной на pay2win. Конечно, подбор игроков работает по кубкам, а не по уровню пешек, включая кубки и общий крит. урон. Если новая пешка метовая - каждая вторая игра будет проиграна, даже если играет лоу скилл, пока ты не получишь эту пешку. Играет в игру мало людей. Этажей в CO-OP мало, но находится игра далеко не всегда быстро, особенно ночью, по ощущениям около 500-1500 реальных игроков. Да, кстати, еще заметил, что раньше в PvP тебе давали слабого бота после нескольких проигрышей. Сейчас это только в Co-Op, но только если никого в поиске нет, такое тоже бывает. title: Fun game that gets no love
text:
Fun game that gets no love. This type of game isn’t for everyone but for me its a creative game where you make different decks with dice to defeat enemies along a path and that just speaks to me; being able to make different decks, seeing whats sticks an what doesn’t, is a lot of fun. But as I play more often, I notice just how little attention this games get.. 

You can see that the game hasn’t been updated in about four or so months but beyond that, many legendary dice (highest rarity) still don’t get traits to make them equal or even just viable compared to other ones. You also notice the lack of playerbase with how long queues take and how crew raids get little activity. 

One of my biggest gripes outside of the lack of content is the lack of balancing between legendary dice, both within it’s own rarity and also amongst the lower rarity dice. Many dice just will never get used which isn’t uncommon, you often ditch your starter equipment the second you get shiny new armor in an rpg but in a game that depends on deck construction and creativity, it’s very saddening to not have many options outside of the handful of non legendary dice.

I haven’t joined any discords or online spaces yet but I honestly feel you shouldn’t have to in order to enjoy a game. I have a lot of comments on the game but these were some standouts for me. I really love this game and want to see it grow, I’m simply disappointed to see it not get that love from the developers.

title: This turned awful really quickly
text:
This turned awful really quickly. This game is really fun… that is until you get to a point where everyone has every dice imaginable and it’s no longer possible to win without having two or three meta decks

Half the dice are unusable other than these few meta ones. I’ve seen the constellation star dice one shot everything on the board after round 30 just because someone clicked the button. All they have to do is mass pile up those dice until they have a ton on their board.

The ying yang dice are the same. Stupidest dice the developers could have possibly made. It’s literally just a fill your board with only that dice and you win the game.

Then we have the forge dice that I see everyone demolish with because when paired with the time dice it negates any negatives that running the forge dice had. Normally you have to consume another dice to level it up but with the time dice you can just reverse your board and keep the level up.

These three decks paired with the stupid growth dice, joker dice, random dice, cracked dice, or growth dice just break the game. No player that has these dice doesn’t run them because they are that broken.

Developers, honestly please pay attention to your game. I really like this game but it’s so ruined for me because you guys have made 2-3 decks that work and have neglected everything else about your game.

Not to mention you’ve now made it so people can just pay to get all the good dice and win which defeats the purpose of getting better at your game.

If you’re going to download this game. I recommend against it. It is unfortunately a game that has lost all of its quality, and fails to be fun anymore. Thank you for reading.

title: A neat concept but….
text:
A neat concept but….. The game is a cool concept, but that’s all I can say nice about it.  The charm quickly wears off as you are quickly assaulted by ads.

- Want to get all the power ups for a round?  Watch an ad.
- Oh boy the difficulty is ramping up quickly.  Better watch that ad to get those power ups now.
- Ooops you died to a tough wave?  Better watch that ad to revive, and oh no the ad broke the wave and you can’t complete the stage. 
- Oh wow you really are going to need the free currency to power up faster, better watch an ad to double your rewards. 
- Oh hey you also get a “spell pack” to unlock a single hidden card out of 3 which represent new power ups for a stage. Want to get another random card of 3?  That’s gonna be another ad. 

And you pretty much get the idea. Not to mention since the whole premise of the game is built on RNG that you can only adjust by buying power ups or hoping for the right power up to appear.  And as soon as you hit the second area you are hit by a bunch of micro transactions to further power up your characters. Just not worth it and uninstalled.

title: Ad monster
text:
Ad monster. This game could be amazing, and if you’re willing to fork out 6.99 for no ads it would be.

I want to be clear, ads don’t inherently ruin games but the way they do ads in this game does. Ads for everything, ads to double rewards after match is fine, ads to get double pack is fine but ads to get all the bonuses in the match? No fun, and often you feel like you have to do it. Then, a lot of times if you don’t get all the bonuses with the ad, it plays the ad *anyways*.

I’ve watched more ads with this game than any other game I’ve played, they’re atrocious and there’s no point in a daily session that you feel like you’ve finally outpaced the ads. This game forces you into 5-6 ads in a 15 minute session. It’s absolutely egregious, and what’s sad is that it’s a great game, it’s an interesting idea, the app is well polished, just be prepared to pay 6.99 if you want to play for real. And the bonuses in the shop for spending money are too great. This game makes you feel like if you aren’t spending money or watching 5 ads every 20 minutes that you’re seriously missing out. Watching ads should be a bonus, spending money should give you a slight to moderate advantage.

What the design of this game tells me is that whoever was in charge of monetization never actually played the game, is greedy, and/or doesn’t think the game will survive on its own merits.

This game feels like it was bought by a private equity firm, it’s being exploited like Red Lobster. 

You can make money off your game, but make the people who run monetization actually play it, ask them, is this fun if you don’t buy? If it isn’t, your monetization is bad. You need F2P players, they will *always* be your lifeblood and you’re going to lose them with this setup. You might be losing me and this sort of game is my jam.

What a shame.

title: Lots of Potential, Not There Yet
text:
Lots of Potential, Not There Yet. The game itself is fun and has a lot of potential, but it pushes you very hard to spend money. I gave in and bought a couple of things, starting with the ad free option and later Electra. The ad free option makes the game feel much easier since you can collect all three cards at once without watching ads. It lets you breeze through the early levels until about level 20, when the game becomes more challenging. I am currently at level 33 and depending on which character I use it can take some time to get through the mobs.

I also spent over forty dollars on Electra to see if she would make a real difference compared to the free characters. She is level 53 now, but I actually prefer the Knight at the same level. Her abilities look flashier, but she is not stronger than the free characters you already get. In fact, I still prefer the Mage since his abilities deal more damage more quickly than most.

Survival mode is a nice addition since it helps you earn more coins for castle and armor upgrades, but the game does become repetitive. The monsters cycle on rotation with little variety, and I have run into bugs. For example, when I reached level 100, the castle health upgrade did not actually unlock for me.

Overall, Dice vs Monsters has potential, but at the moment it feels more like a money grab than a balanced game. If you want to play, I recommend sticking to the free content. Extra characters are not worth the money.

So I’ll give this game 4 stars due to the potential and hopefully the characters you do buy will actually be a bit better over the free ones.

title: Be Careful...
text:
Be Careful.... The gameplay itself is quite enjoyable. There are fun characters and designs, unique dice defense mechanics, the progression system is fun. However... I would personally NOT recommend this game by any means except for maybe 10 minutes of fun if you are just that bored. 

1. If you play this game and decide to make purchases, and idk if it is just me, but keep in mind that there is apparently no account linking to save historical game data. A while ago I made a few purchases for a character I liked, ad removals, and the gameplay perma speedup bonus, but it's now all gone. I took a break, uninstalled the game, reinstalled it to see what updates were made, and all my purchases were gone. With no option to log in or connect to an account, I chose the option to restore purchases, but nothing happened.

2. Speaking of purchases, i love supporting free games and I get companies have to make money, but the cost for almost everything is ludicrous. Pure insanity. Truly. $60 for ad removal on a mobile game? How in the world is this game worth that when it's just a mobile game, you do not get all the content, and still have to pay an insane amount to unlock content such as the other heroes? The heroes, btw, are mostly between the $35-$60 range and they don't come with everything unlocked. You can still make additional purchases for their level boosting and ability unlocks, which are also crazy expensive.

3. The progression system is WEAK. Gear takes forever to farm with minimal opportunities to get gear. The gear upgrading is slow. The abilities are easy to unlock with minimal to no advancement after they are upgraded. The upgrading of abilities is also far too easy and ends quickly with a bug that allows you to upgrade at the cost of 32 resources vs the intended 56. There aren't many characters to unlock yourself, you get them fast (except for one that requires continuous play for a month). The castle mechanic is flat with upgrades unlocked early and only one set of options (not actually customizable).

4. Balancing is a serious issue here as well. There are clearly superior ability choices to choose from and one route that will take you significantly farther in the game. It's not even complex. Even heroes themselves and their upgrades/abilities are significantly imbalanced compared to one another. There is literally one free hero that can take you twice as far in the game with fewer upgrades.

5. There is a major lack of content. Again, the gameplay is fun, but there is really only one thing you will do in the entire game. No PvP. No unique rounds. Systematic repetition in quantities for various stages, etc.

title: Insane Amount of Ads
text:
Insane Amount of Ads. The game itself is fun, but you’re overwhelmed with ads. Each game will end up having two ads that pop up involuntarily, then the ability to double rewards at the end for an ad and then the ability to double spell rewards for another ad. 

I understand that games have progressed to a point where they make money from ads and from people purchasing packs to disable ads, that’s usually a max of $15-$20 USD. 

This game requests that the complete removal of all ads for every part of the game (this includes involuntary ads, spell pack doubling, reward pack doubling and receiving all dice upgrades in a game) for a whopping $58 USD to remove all ads. 

It’s the most predatory insane cost for ad removal I’ve ever seen and I’ve played a ton of mobile games over the last 13 years with a lot of wild pricing. 

TL;DR: Fun-ish game but $58 USD for removing all ads? You can kick rocks, instant delete.

title: Ad Fest and Manipulation
text: Ad Fest and Manipulation. I don’t like the way this game conducts ads, as they start off with none through the first stage, but then they slowly start adding them to stages. I think I’m on the 4th stage and I now get 2 ads per run, one in the beginning and another in the middle (Which interrupts gameplay and usually causes sound/visual glitches after the ad ends until you restart the app). These ads are ALL double-skip ads (Where you can’t exit the ad until clicking the third time), which is very annoying. Lastly, this form of ad scaling is highly manipulative, as you don’t always want to stop playing if you’ve already sunk time into the game without egregious ads at the start, so when they start popping up all the time your brain might think “Well, I already sunk an hour into this, might as well keep playing”. Seriously avoid if you can’t stand ads every 30-60 seconds. This doesn’t even include the optional ads for upgrades which last around 1 minute total. I miss the days of the 30 second ad…

I’m already grinding enough in life lol I don’t need more. To offer some constructive critique, lower that ad removal price. You already have tinker at $50. title: Ads Galore
text:
Ads Galore. This game has a bunch of potential and is quite fun. The mechanic is great, and while it does feel a little luck inducing, that’s how dice work. 

However you are going to get spammed with ads. And I’m not talking opportunities for ads to get additional rewards. I’m talking ads every 30 seconds in the middle of a round. Leveling up became something I dreaded because I knew I would be stuck watching ads.

I’m deleting this game because while it was fun, it stopped being fun because of all the ads. Don’t waste your time.

title: Played 48 Hours Straight (Almost)
text: Played 48 Hours Straight (Almost). I do adore this game. It’s so fun. The ads aren’t too annoying. I played it nonstop over the weekend. But on round 14, I have gotten to the point in the game when the rounds/locations/monsters now repeat at unbelievably hard difficulty. The waves come too quickly, too high hp, and my heroes are highly upgraded and can’t attack fast enough to level up in combat or add another ally. I’ve been at the same round level for hours and I’m about darn near to delete it. I refuse to play a game that demands I pay to succeed or demands I watch ads to get temp boosters to succeed.
